prompts.name: plant-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game animation sprite sheet, genuinely transparent background. A NEW rooted CARNIVOROUS SNAPPING PLANT for Grim Run, painted gothic dark fantasy matching reference materials and silhouette style. Not a stalk or crop: one broad hinged predatory mouth with ivory thorn-like teeth, dark burgundy mouth interior, icy blue-gray fleshy leaves, a curved thorny stem and a compact firmly rooted leaf/rock base. Frost on teeth and edges, muted tundra palette. FOUR columns TWO rows, EIGHT distinct sequential poses across one rising-and-snapping cycle: low closed resting maw; stem bending upward mouth beginning to open; head higher jaws spreading; high wide-open toothed maw; high snapping shut; recoil downward; near-low relaxing jaws; return to closed low rest. The root/leaf base stays EXACTLY same position and size, feet baseline consistent, stem naturally bends/extends, whole plant never bounces off ground. All poses same anatomy and scale. Rooted base occupies bottom 15% of every cell, maw changes height within upper half. Full silhouette INSIDE each equal cell with at least 15% transparent margin; no overlapping cells. Canvas 1536x1024, no labels, no text, no effects, no scenery, no grid. Genuine transparent alpha, no checkerboard.

prompts.name: bone-fragments-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game particle atlas on genuinely transparent background for Grim Run. 4 columns by 3 rows containing TWELVE separate isolated recognizable BONE FRAGMENTS, all painted gothic cartoon dark fantasy matching the reference's ivory skull/scythe bone shading. Include three small jointed long-bone pieces, two curved rib pieces, two jagged splintered bones, two knuckle/vertebra pieces, a small broken jawbone fragment, and two short rounded bone ends. NOT a full skeleton, no gore, no skin. Warm ivory lit edges, blue-gray/charcoal shaded sides, strong silhouettes, easily readable at 5–15px game size. Each piece fills 45–65% of its equal cell, is separate from other cells, generous transparent padding. All pieces will tumble independently in an outward explosion. No explosion or glow painted into sheet; individual bones only. No text, no labels, no grids, no ground or background. 1536x1024 canvas.

prompts.name: cloak-roots-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent cloak-component sprite sheet for the EXACT Grim Run Reaper in the reference. THREE columns with ONE small isolated CLOAK OVERLAP FOLD in each cell, no full character. These are cloth patches to conceal the roots of wings as they emerge from under the cloak at the BACK of the left shoulder. Each patch is a curled irregular layered flap of weathered charcoal/navy fabric with a thin dark crimson underside and crisp painted edge. Leftward tapered torn tips, thicker curved shoulder fold toward the right. Subtle recessed dark slit beneath fold for wing emergence. Frame 1 upright/hover shoulder fold; frame 2 compressed forward leaning airborne tuck fold; frame 3 slightly lifted twisting attack fold. SAME cloth palette and same local material scale as reference. No flesh, no skull, no wing, no bone, no harness or metal mounting plate. Do not draw a complete cloak. Each small component surrounded by generous genuine transparency. Three neatly separated equal cells, no text, labels, glow, shadows outside fabric or grid. 1536x1024 canvas.

prompts.name: shrine-reach-v2
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation sprite sheet for Grim Run. Reference defines the EXACT accepted Reaper character and three key acquisition poses. Preserve skull shape, cyan eye, charcoal hood, layered crimson-lined cloak, bronze armor and same bone scythe leaning BEHIND body. Full-body standing right-facing Reaper, feet planted at one constant baseline. Exactly FOUR columns TWO rows of EIGHT distinct small-increment poses, read left-to-right then next row. Keep head/torso size and feet spacing identical in every frame. Each character centered INSIDE its own equal cell with 15% transparent padding; no crossing or touching another cell. NO crossbow in hands: separate weapon attached at runtime. No text, grid, background, effects, extra characters. Genuine transparent background. 1536x1024 canvas. Animate FIRST segment: neutral hands at chest/waist -> elbows moving forward -> hands extending forward toward relic -> arms reaching forward/up. Eight different in-between drawings: frames 1–2 low relaxed arms, 3–4 elbows unfolding, 5–6 hands reaching diagonally upward, 7–8 arms nearly extended forward at shoulder height. Hands do NOT reach overhead yet. Gaze follows hands slightly upward; shoulders and robe respond subtly. Frame 8 joins first reference key pose.

prompts.name: foothills
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production transparent backdrop SUPPORT SPRITE for a floating jump-plus-attack thorn obstacle in Grim Run. Painted gothic dark fantasy, highly organic hand-painted materials. gnarled weathered brown roots, muted moss and tufts of dry mountain grass growing around irregular gray rock. The support grows from a broad irregular rooted rock base in the LOWER LEFT, winds upward through an ASYMMETRIC S-CURVE, splits into two short curling offshoots, and tapers into a twisted thorny tip near UPPER RIGHT. Clearly visible bends, curved contours, knots, crooked forks, varying thickness and broken silhouettes. Avoid a straight diagonal rod, ramp, plank, triangular wedge or straight framing edge. Leave large clean transparent holes between branches. Entire isolated shape inside landscape canvas with narrow transparent margins; base ends in irregular roots and natural rock lobes, no square crop. No character, no foreground obstacle clump, no scenery, no sky, no text, no glow or haze. It must look physically attached to terrain at its base while curling toward an airborne thorn knot. Genuine transparent background. 1536x1024 canvas.
